language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hey, I'm Zander and I'm pretty excited about my family's camping trip. We'll be camping near the beach so I hope to see some penguins. Maybe my dad will even take me on a shark-spotting excursion.
I'm anxious to see how the temperature changes here since we are so close to the beach. I'm curious how it can be so warm during the day and why it cools off so much at night. So much to learn!
But first, we just arrived at the campsite and we've got to set up camp.
Help Zander and his family set up their campsite so he can begin exploring the area.

It rained this afternoon. Have you ever wondered how rain is formed and why it falls from the sky? I have! I know that the hot sun can evaporate water. When that happens the water vapor rises to the sky. There it cools and the vapor turns into water again and falls to the ground as rain. Do you think you can fill in the rain cycle for me?
